verdict.rationale: monday.com's own developer docs describe subscribing to platform events such as `create_item` and `change_column_value`, and reacting to real-time changes like a new user joining or a board being created to keep your backend in sync. That is a direct event-subscription capability, but the evidence never shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks to a consumer-supplied URL, and the only 'webhook' mention is about connecting agents in. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of webhook URL registration and outbound HTTP delivery, payload/signature/retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Listen for real-time events and run your workflow the moment data changes.
Respond when a new user joins or a board is created to keep your backend in sync.
Fire when an agent is messaged, assigned an item, or mentioned in an update.
